data.name: Khwahan
data.gender_notes: Khwahan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khwahan is a Persian name that means 'ruler of the universe' or 'king of the world'. It is a name that signifies power, authority, and leadership. The name Khwahan carries the meaning “Ruler of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khwahan usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Khwahan is associated with the concept of Tawhid, or the oneness of God, emphasizing the individual's submission to the ultimate ruler of the universe.
data.etymology: Khwahan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khwahan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: خواهان
in_arabic.meaning: الخواهان تعني الراغبون أو الراجون في الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخواهان هو اسم يدل على الرغبة أو الرجاء في الحصول على شيء ما، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الرجاء والتمني. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالجذر اللغوي 'خ و هـ' الذي يعني الرغبة أو الإرادة.

in_urdu.name: خواہان
in_urdu.meaning: خواہان کا مطلب ہے خواہش کرنے والے یا راغب
in_urdu.long_meaning: خواہان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو خواہش یا رغبت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور یہ عربی جڑ 'خ و هـ' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رغبت یا ارادہ کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں روایتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ख्वाहान
in_hindi.meaning: ख्वाहान का अर्थ है इच्छा करने वाले या इच्छुक
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख्वाहान एक ऐसा नाम है जो इच्छा या आकांक्षा को दर्शाता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'خ و هـ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है इच्छा या इरादा करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: خواهان
in_pashto.meaning: خواهان د معنی دا لری چی غواړی یا راغی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خواهان یو نوم دی چی د غوښتنې یا رغبت څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي. دا نوم د عربی ژبې د ريښې 'خ و هـ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چی د غوښتنې یا ارادې معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو په منځ کې ځای لري.

in_english.name: Khwahan
in_english.meaning: Wish, desire or one who wishes for something
in_english.long_meaning: Khwahan is a name that signifies one who wishes or desires something. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'خ و هـ' (kh-w-h), which conveys the meaning of wishing or desiring. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting a person's hopeful and aspirational nature. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing positive personality traits such as optimism and determination.
